ask.gpu: video memory in use: {used} of {total} MB
ask.declined: You said "not now" - it asks again at {time}
res.notUsed: not used in the last 24 h

res.none: No resources yet. Add them to ~/.unreal-agent-hub/config.json or to a project's .unreal-agent-hub.json.
node.idle: nothing heavy runs on its desktop
node.hereTitle: Remote runs will queue and ask you first, until you press "I left" (or the mark expires)
toast.opening: Opening the chat in the desktop app
toast.here: Marked: you are at the machine
toast.granted: Done - the run may take the machine
toast.declined: Got it - it will ask again later
lang.label: Language
foot: Scripts and chats take resources themselves (hub lock, hub hold, hooks, MCP); nobody is ever pushed out of a lock, and nothing here stops processes.
state.tip.working: the chat is taking its turn
state.tip.background: the turn has ended, but work runs in the background (a command, a subagent, a monitor); it wakes the chat by itself
state.tip.idle: the turn has ended and nothing runs in the background
state.tip.needs-owner: the chat asks for a permission or waits for your answer
state.tip.stalled: the hooks say it is working, but there has been no event for over an hour: the chat has most likely crashed; open it and say "continue"
state.tip.unknown: no status events from this chat
state.tip.gone: the agent process of this chat has ended
h.chatsSub: first those that need you or went silent, then working and working in the background
h.subagentsSub: Agent calls of the Claude Code chats on this machine
h.cloudSub: started by chats in the Claude cloud
sub.hint: the task is what the chat wrote in its Agent call; "quiet" means the subagent's transcript has been silent for over 5 minutes
sub.noneRunning: no subagent is running right now
sub.noneRecent: no subagents in the last 3 hours
sub.bgTip: started in the background: the chat does not wait for it
cloud.none: no cloud sessions started in the last 48 hours
cloud.seenTip: A cloud session sends no events to this computer: open the link to see its state.
chart.loadSub: share of the window held, takes, waiting
foot.background: "Working in the background": the chat's turn has ended, but background commands, subagents or monitors still run (background_tasks of the Stop event).
chart.chatTimeSub: over the window: turns · background · waiting for you
chart.chatTimeNone: no chat worked in this window
tl.hint: now on the left, scroll right for earlier · {d} in all
tl.onlyInView: only chats that worked in view
